children: At the 2026 Kuaishou Guanghe Creator Conference on August 29, Kuaishou Technology founder, chairman and CEO Cheng Yixiao said the platform has developed 632 interest circles and 4,112 sub-interest tags, with users averaging 16 long-term interests each. According to Jiemian News, Cheng also said creators focused on niche verticals earn 2.2 times as much per month on average as broad-reach creators.

title: Kuaishou Says Platform Has 632 Interest Circles and 4,112 Tags
